A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–D. The publication reformatting and relocated material do not prevent reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D report original sampler evaluations, runtime measurements, discretization studies, and VAE reconstructions.

after.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D retain these original experimental results, including numerical benchmark comparisons and runtime measurements.

M1.justification: The sampling procedures, training objectives, Langevin parametrization, local-search variants, and discretization schemes are retained. Making the TB centering constant explicit does not establish a procedural change: learned normalization and the shifted objective were already discussed in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate 25GMM, Funnel, Manywell, LGCP, German Credit, Breast Cancer, and conditional MNIST VAE sampling. Newly cited latent-space and discrete-space applications are not additional evaluated tasks.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same PIS, TB, VarGrad, DB, and FL-DB comparisons and their reported Langevin-parametrization and local-search variants. The additional citations do not introduce evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Training budgets, discretization settings, evaluation-step sweeps, ELBO metrics, and the 2,000-sample evaluation remain unchanged. The Random and Equidistant definitions move from Appendix C.2 into Section 4 with their existing parameters.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same training- and inference-discretization sensitivity studies, parametrization and local-search comparisons, and VAE reconstruction examples. Relocating the discretization illustration adds no analysis.

E5.justification: The uncertainty entries in Tables 2–3 and plotted uncertainty are retained. The runtime figure reports means and standard deviations over three runs in both versions; no new seed, repeated-run, or statistical-estimation practice is documented.

E6.justification: All numerical estimate-and-uncertainty entries in Tables 2–3 match. Corresponding performance plots and VAE reconstructions also retain the same results, including the instability associated with coarse uniform training.

T1.justification: Equation (7) changes the stated TB definition from an uncentered squared log-density ratio to one centered at c, with accompanying explanation. This is a limited formal-definition revision: v1 already discussed arbitrary-c convergence after Proposition 3.3, and the convergence propositions and appendix proofs are otherwise retained.

C1.justification: The abstract and principal contributions retain the same claims about asymptotic objective equivalences and computationally efficient training with coarse nonuniform discretizations. The expanded future-work discussion does not change the demonstrated contribution.

C2.justification: Section 2.1 adds an explicit soft-Bellman/path-consistency interpretation of the objectives. Appendix B.1 connects the assumptions to smooth Lipschitz MLPs, and the conclusion discusses further latent-space and discrete-space applications. Existing performance interpretations and instability qualifications remain.

D1.justification: Appendix B.1 newly identifies the models as GELU-activated MLPs, adding implementation information without establishing an architecture change. Training settings, hardware disclosure, and the code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: V2 adds targeted references and positioning, including Nachum et al. on path consistency, Denker et al. on gradient subsampling, and recent latent-space and discrete-space samplers. Additional mathematical references support the existing assumptions and derivations; the overall positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: V2 makes targeted explanatory edits, expands the conclusion, updates author/publication information, and moves the discretization definitions into Section 4. The overall narrative and section sequence remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: The journal template changes typography, the author block, and display sizing and placement. V1 Figure 7 is redrawn and relocated as v2 Figure 4, while v2 Figure 6 adds a marker-area explanation. The experimental plots and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: Moving the discretization definitions and illustration into Section 4, disclosing the activations, and sharpening literature connections modestly improve accessibility and documentation. These gains are limited by unchanged scientific evidence and some new presentation inconsistencies, including Theorem cross-references to results still labeled Proposition or Lemma.
